propositions: A single pathological markdown field can hang pandoc indefinitely because pypandoc provides no timeout and subprocess.run(timeout=) reaps only the direct child, allowing spinning grandchildren to survive

The renderer must spawn pandoc as its own process group with a caller-side wall-clock timeout via communicate(timeout=dc_pandoc_timeout_s) and reap the entire group via rebar._proc.reap_process_group on TimeoutExpired
On timeout or non-zero exit each affected unit degrades to its original markdown without raising, leaving rendered output byte-identical to the landed renderer across the full corpus
The pypandoc-binary wheel pinned at version 1.15 (pandoc 3.6.1, GPL-licensed) must be verified in CI and recorded in a new repo-root NOTICE file with licence provenance
The dc_pandoc_timeout_s config (default 10s) must be reachable from config file and environment variables across the standard reconciler config surface
Safe-run batching was descoped after measurement showed it yields only 12% fewer spawns while changing output on 12% of bodies — an unacceptable trade for a silent rendering change
